keyEvents.text: Lucas Café (Iberia 1999) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Iberia 1999 1, Getafe 0. Giorgi Kobuladze (Iberia 1999) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Ramón Terrats (Getafe) is shown the yellow card.
Davinchi (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Iberia 1999 1, Getafe 0.
Substitution, Getafe. Zaid Romero replaces Davinchi.
Substitution, Getafe. Enes Ünal replaces Ramón Terrats.
Substitution, Getafe. Orel Mangala replaces Mario Martín.
Orel Mangala (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Orel Mangala (Getafe) for a bad foul.
Substitution, Getafe. Francho Serrano replaces Borja Mayoral.
Substitution, Getafe. Andrés García replaces Kiko Femenía.
Giorgi Kobuladze (Iberia 1999) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Iberia 1999. Stephen Ende replaces Lucas Café.
Substitution, Iberia 1999. Ibrahim Alhassan replaces Giorgi Kutsia.
Substitution, Iberia 1999. Nikoloz Botchorishvili replaces Giorgi Kobuladze because of an injury.
Andrés García (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Nikoloz Dadiani (Iberia 1999).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Iberia 1999. Eldar Kuliiev replaces Nikoloz Dadiani because of an injury.
Substitution, Iberia 1999. Zviad Natchkebia replaces Nika Sikharulashvili.
